response.sql: WITH per_product AS (SELECT p.product_id, pc.product_type_description AS type_desc, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Order_Items) AS item_share FROM Products p JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description), per_type AS (SELECT type_desc, AVG(avg_qty) AS avg_qty, AVG(item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM per_product GROUP BY type_desc) SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS avg_avg_quantity, AVG(avg_item_count) AS avg_item_count, AVG(avg_item_share) AS avg_item_share FROM per_type
